google_review_notes: No login required. Blood Pressure Log opens on the Log tab after a 3-card intro (Skip). Type systolic, diastolic and optional pulse, choose arm and position, add tags or a note and tap Save reading; the colour chip shows the category of the 2017 ACC/AHA guideline (try 150/95 and 185/125 - at 180/120 or higher a calm 'seek medical help' note appears). History lists readings (tap to edit or delete); Trends shows 7/30/90 day charts, averages, morning vs evening and a shareable doctor summary. Optional reminders (morning/evening measurement, medication time, a dated re-check and appointment reminder) are in Settings and ask for notification permission only when switched on. Pro and Remove Ads are one-time in-app products (Settings > Purchases); Restore purchases is in the same section. All data stays on the device. HEALTH APPS DECLARATION: the app is a personal blood-pressure diary. It is not a medical device and gives no diagnosis, treatment or dosing advice; onboarding, the Log and Trends screens, Settings > About and the listing state that categories are information only and users should talk to a health professional, and name the 2017 ACC/AHA guideline. No health data leaves the device (Data Safety: no health data collected).
apple_review_notes: No login required. To test in-app purchases open Settings (gear, top right) > Purchases: Go Pro (pro_lifetime) or Remove ads (remove_ads); Restore purchases is in the same section. The app is a personal blood-pressure diary, not a medical device, and shows 'not a diagnosis / not medical advice' wording; all data stays on device. No demo account needed.
